name: MarketMan
tagline: MarketMan tracks inventory, supplier orders, and recipe costs for restaurants, cafes, and bars, predicting ingredient usage and flagging when costs drift from a recipe's target margin. It reconciles supplier invoices automatically and warns managers before a slow ingredient spoils or a fast one runs out mid-shift. Independent cafes and multi-location restaurant groups use it to keep food cost percentages in check without hiring a dedicated inventory manager.
